mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an imminent monetary easing policy, which reduces the risk-free rate and increases the present value of future equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a monthly reading, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that typically precede a recession, causing equity investors to demand higher risk premiums and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate earnings growth prospects deteriorate, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term in a regression model has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending supply shock that disrupts corporate production and supply chains, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in reduced earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over the past month indicates accelerating inflation, which typically leads the Federal Reserve to maintain a restrictive monetary policy, causing equity valuations to contract and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) falls below 50,000, it signals a weakening labor market that often precedes a slowdown in economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where PAYEMS is below 50,000, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,300,000 units in a monthly reading, it signals a contraction in the residential construction sector that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST is below 1300.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past two months indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth is expected to slow.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.
